newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-LARA OUT FIRST BALL BEFORE RAIN HALTS ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LARA OUT FIRST BALL BEFORE RAIN HALTS ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Brian Lara was out first ball before rain stopped the second one-day international with West Indies struggling against India on Sunday.
West Indies were 14 for two from six overs when play was interrupted at Queen's Park Oval.
Put in to bat, West Indies lost opener Stuart Williams (3) and Lara (0) to consecutive balls from fast bowler Venkatesh Prasad, who has two for seven off three overs.
Shivnarine Chanderpaul (8) and Carl Hooper (2) are the not out batsmen.
